body.title: GitHub signoff request and state
body.summary: Extend the request spec and ref types (AMD-16), declare signoff-request in the GitHub adapter and implement openSignoffRequest as a pull request from a branch holding the committed artifacts, linked from the unit issue, and readSignoffState from the review decision and merge state, with contract tests over a fake gh.
acceptanceChecks: loadTracker accepts signoff-request once declared and still rejects a tracker that lacks it
openSignoffRequest opens a pull request, links it from the unit issue and returns its ref and url
readSignoffState maps the review decision and merge state to open, changing-requested and completed
Failure kinds map to the port's failure kinds

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-signoff.test.ts: loadTracker accepts signoff-request once declared; openSignoffRequest opens a pull request from the branch, links it from the unit issue and returns its ref and url; readSignoffState maps review decision and merge state to open, changes-requested and completed; failure kinds map to PortResult kinds
